messages.content: Walk me through what to actually do the first time I get a chargeback.

First, don't panic and don't take it personally - chargebacks happen even to legitimate creators. Check your platform's dashboard for the reason code, since that tells you whether it's fraud, a billing dispute, or the customer simply not recognizing the charge. Gather any evidence you have of the transaction being legitimate - message logs, timestamps, delivery confirmation if applicable. Most platforms let you submit a response or dispute within a specific window, so don't sit on it. Finally, if chargebacks become frequent from the same pattern, look at whether your billing descriptor is confusing people, since that's a common and fixable cause.
